headlines.title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump’s Bid to Restrict Mail-in Ballot Rules
headlines.description: The Supreme Court on Monday rejected President Donald Trump’s efforts to restrict mail-in voting ahead of the midterm elections in November. NBC’s Laura Jarrett joins TODAY to break down what’s at stake with the decision.

headlines.title: Finneas and other acts exit Ed Sheeran tour in protest of Macklemore being dropped
headlines.description: All of Sheeran’s listed openers have left the tour after New England Patriots owner Robert Kraft worked to have Macklemore removed.

headlines.title: Kennedy Center to close for two years as Trump says renovation hinges on his name
headlines.description: The Kennedy Center board voted to immediately close the main building for a two-year renovation, hours after a federal judge blocked efforts to put President Trump’s name on the building. NBC News’ Hallie Jackson reports.

headlines.title: Iran war driving up inflation for Americans, CBO report says
headlines.description: The Congressional Budget Office estimates inflation will continue to rise in the first quarter of next year.

headlines.title: Watch highlights of the 2026 Emmy Awards in 3 minutes
headlines.description: Apple TV's "Widow's Bay", "Pluribus," and HBO’s "The Pitt" received major awards at the 2026 Emmy Awards, with horror-comedy "Widow's Bay" taking home some of the night’s biggest awards, including outstanding comedy series, outstanding directing, outstanding lead actor Matthew Rhys, and outstanding supporting actress for Kate O’Flynn.

headlines.title: Texas college quarterback apologizes for comments about violent AI video
headlines.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning apologized for referencing an AI video showing his coach slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe. “In my press conference yesterday, I made an insensitive comment about an AI video. There is nothing funny about it,” Manning wrote.

headlines.title: Kash Patel defends FBI’s new policy on bestiality at Senate hearing
headlines.description: Sen. John Kennedy grilled the FBI director about a recently revised policy that doesn’t automatically disqualify job applicants who have engaged in bestiality.

headlines.title: Senate votes to move forward with Protect College Sports Act
headlines.description: The Senate on Tuesday voted to advance the Protect College Sports Act, an NCAA-backed, bipartisan bill aimed at setting federal guidelines for college sports amid a rapidly shifting landscape.

headlines.title: House panel votes to hold Epstein associate Leon Black in contempt
headlines.description: The move came after the House Oversight Committee accused the former Wall Street private equity investor of ignoring subpoenas in its probe of Jeffrey Epstein.

headlines.title: Judge requests federal probe into Philly DA Larry Krasner
headlines.description: A federal judge said Philadelphia District Attorney Larry Krasner may have committed crimes in his handling of a post-conviction case.

headlines.title: GOP shifts message on costs as Iran war drags on: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Sahil Kapur examines how the Iran war is undercutting what was once a political advantage for Republicans.
